children: G-10 central banks are currently acting with a high level of policy synchronicity that falls short of what was seen in the aftermath of the Covid-19 pandemic but looks a lot like the period of policy tightening before the global financial crisis 20 years ago, says Taylor Nugent, economist at NAB. If the Reserve Bank of Australia hikes next week, the proportion of G-10 central banks hiking in September would be at least 50%. The Norges Bank meeting on Thursday is also live, and a hike would tip it to 60%, he adds. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
